slides.texto_narrado: Careful what you skip ordering in January — some of it, you can't just order late and catch up.
Chicks. Bees. Certain seed varieties that sell out by February. January is the deadline, not a suggestion.
I found out the hard way — called in March for chicks, got waitlisted until May. Lost half my growing season for eggs.
Now I keep one list, every October, before the catalogs even land: what sells out, and by when.
This year's list went out in September. Everything's already on its way.
